items.title: AWS Patches Critical RCE and Escalate Privileges in Research and Engineering Studio
items.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) has released an important security bulletin addressing three severe vulnerabilities in its Research and Engineering Studio (RES). These flaws could allow authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root and escalate privileges within a targeted cloud environment. items.title: Can We Trust AI? No – But Eventually We Must
items.description: From hallucinations and bias to model collapse and adversarial abuse, today’s AI is built on probability rather than truth, yet enterprises are deploying it at speed without fully understanding the risks.
